content: {"reasoning":"The required authorization was absent, the retro-authorization window is closed, and the payer offers no peer-to-peer path; a medical-necessity appeal has also already been attempted. The $495.37 deductible does not become patient responsibility on an authorization denial, so billing the patient would exceed the contractual patient share.
